description: This file contains helper functions for rendering UI components in a web application, including tab rendering, session management, theme toggles, and session key parsing. It interacts with various parts of the app state and external modules to generate dynamic HTML templates.

methods.name: resolveSidebarChatSessionKey
methods.description: Determines the main chat session key based on the current app state, prioritizing snapshot defaults or defaulting to 'main'.

methods.name: resetChatStateForSessionSwitch
methods.description: Resets chat-related state variables when switching sessions, including chat message, stream, and UI resets.

methods.name: renderTab
methods.description: Generates HTML for a navigation tab, handling active state and click behavior, including special handling for the 'chat' tab to switch sessions.

methods.name: renderCronFilterIcon
methods.description: Creates an SVG icon with an optional badge indicating hidden cron sessions.

methods.name: renderChatSessionSelect
methods.description: Renders a session selection dropdown with groups, allowing session switching.

methods.name: renderChatControls
methods.description: Renders chat control buttons for refresh, toggles for thinking, tool calls, focus mode, and cron sessions, with associated icons and behaviors.

methods.name: renderChatMobileToggle
methods.description: Renders a mobile-specific toggle button for chat controls, including session switching and toggle buttons.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches the current chat session, resetting state, loading history, and updating URL and settings.

methods.name: refreshSessionOptions
methods.description: Loads session options asynchronously, including global and unknown sessions.

methods.name: renderChatModelSelect
methods.description: Creates a dropdown for selecting chat models, handling loading states and current override.

methods.name: resolveThinkingTargetModel
methods.description: Determines the provider and model for the current session, considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: buildThinkingOptions
methods.description: Builds a list of thinking level options based on provider, model, and current override.

methods.name: resolveChatThinkingSelectState
methods.description: Resolves the current thinking level override, default label, and options for the session.

methods.name: renderChatThinkingSelect
methods.description: Creates a dropdown for selecting the chat's thinking level, with current selection and change handler.

methods.name: switchChatModel
methods.description: Requests a model change for the current session, updating server and local state, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: patchSessionThinkingLevel
methods.description: Updates the thinking level for a specific session in the local state.

methods.name: switchChatThinkingLevel
methods.description: Changes the thinking level for the current session, updating server and local state, with error handling.

methods.name: resolveSessionKey
methods.description: Parses a session key string to extract type info and fallback display name.

methods.name: resolveSessionDisplayName
methods.description: Determines the display name for a session, considering label, displayName, and fallback.

methods.name: isCronSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key corresponds to a cron session.

methods.name: resolveSessionOptionGroups
methods.description: Generates grouped options for session selection, handling disambiguation and cron filtering.

methods.name: resolveAgentGroupLabel
methods.description: Resolves the display label for an agent ID, including name and identity.

methods.name: resolveSessionScopedOptionLabel
methods.description: Provides a label for session options, considering label, displayName, and session data.

methods.name: renderTopbarThemeModeToggle
methods.description: Renders theme mode toggle buttons with icons and click handlers.

methods.name: renderSidebarConnectionStatus
methods.description: Displays connection status indicator with label and styling.

methods.name: renderThemeToggle
methods.description: Creates a theme selection menu with open/close toggle and options.
